We bring science, data, and collaboration together in a single, full-service CRO model powered by real-world evidence (RWE).

By combining deep cardiovascular expertise, an engaged and diverse network of physicians, and close client partnerships, we transform data into evidence that fuels innovation and leads to better care.

About The Role

The Project Manager is a critical role responsible for planning, coordinating, overseeing, and executing the clinical trials in alignment with the organization's standards and the sponsor's requirements. They serve as the primary liaison for all project-related communications, ensuring that trials are progressing according to plan and that all stakeholders are informed and engaged.

What You'll Do

Plan, coordinate, and oversee all stages of clinical trials, including project planning, budgeting, resource allocation, execution, and closeout.
Ensure that clinical trials are conducted in accordance with the protocol, standard operating procedures (SOPs), good clinical practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory requirements.
Serve as the primary contact for sponsors, investigators, and other stakeholders, providing timely and accurate project updates.
Identify project risks and develop and implement mitigation strategies.
Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to ensure that project goals are met.
Oversee data management activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of clinical trial data.
Conduct regular project meetings, documenting and following up on important actions and decisions.
Prepare and present project reports to senior management and stakeholders.
Demonstrates accountability by completing all mandatory training on time and in accordance with company requirements.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a life science or related field. A master’s degree or relevant certification is preferred. However, a combination of experience and/or education will be taken into consideration.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in clinical project management within a Contract Research Organization (CRO), biotech, or pharmaceutical company.
In-depth understanding of clinical trials, including planning, execution, and regulatory requirements.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
Proficiency in project management software and other relevant tools.

LOCATION AND TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

This is a fully remote position and may be performed anywhere within the United States of America. Occasional domestic travel may be required for company meetings, audits, etc.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.description:
Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state-of-the-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over ~23000 professionals in >160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree.

For additional information about Solenis, please visit www.solenis.com or follow us on social media.

Perks of working with us!

Competitive health + wellness benefit plan
Continuous professional development with many opportunities for growth!
Recharge with 15 days of paid time off
Competitive Salary and Bonuses
401k Plan
Ability to work remotely

Position Summary

You are responsible for leading and supporting capital projects across the North American plant network. You will provide project leadership from initial planning and budgeting through execution, commissioning, and closeout, while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with business objectives. You will provide leadership and guidance to Project Managers and Engineers, support the planning, tracking, forecasting, and budgeting of Capital Expenditures (CapEx), and ensure projects progress effectively through the established Stage Gate process in the multi-million-dollar range.

Key Responsibilities

Lead medium to large-scale capital projects from concept and feasibility through design, construction, commissioning, and project closeout.
Develop and maintain project scope, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and execution strategies.
Coordinate multidisciplinary project teams, including Engineering, Operations, EHS, Finance, Procurement, R&D, and other functional stakeholders.
Monitor project performance and proactively identify and address risks, issues, schedule delays, and cost variances.
Champion project teams through the company's Stage Gate process.
Review project business cases, scopes, cost estimates, schedules, risk assessments, and supporting documentation at key project milestones.
Serve as a resource and mentor to Project Managers, Engineers, and other project team members.
Support continuous improvement initiatives related to capital planning, project execution, cost management, and reporting.
Facilitate effective communication between plant leadership, project teams, Finance, Engineering, and senior management.
Prepare and present project updates and portfolio-level information to leadership.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business, Finance, or a related technical discipline preferred.
10+ years of experience managing capital projects in a manufacturing, industrial, or similar environment.
Extensive working knowledge of capital project processes, including budgeting, forecasting, project accounting, and general accounting policies and procedures.
Strong understanding of project cost management, forecasting, scheduling, and financial reporting.
Strong understanding of construction and engineering principles.
Ownership of Safe work environment for projects.
Experience with Microsoft Office and SAP.
Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and managing projects across multiple sites.
Ability to travel 50-80%

We understand that candidates will not meet every single desired qualification. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve identified and you think you can bring value to the role, we’d love to learn more about you.

At Solenis, we understand that our greatest asset is our people. That is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits which include medical, dental, vision & 401K, and numerous opportunities for professional growth and development. So, if you are interested in working for a world-class company and enjoy solving complex challenges, whether in the lab or the field, consider joining our team.

Solenis is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Affirmative Action Employer, including Minorities / Women/ Veterans / Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Should you require assistance in applying to this opportunity, please reach out to Solenis Talent Acquisition at talentacquisition@solenis.com

The expected compensation range for this position is between $107,500.00 and $157,663.00 plus discretionary bonuses. The exact compensation may vary based on your skills, experience and other factors permitted by law.

Title
: Technical Program Manager - Cybersecurity

Location

Job Type

Industry:
Retail

About The Role

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager for a leading enterprise organization operating in the retail industry. This role will support a large-scale enterprise data platform migration, with a primary focus on coordinating cybersecurity requirements, technical dependencies, and execution across multiple technology teams.

The Technical Program Manager will work closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, Architecture, Data and Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, and Product teams to ensure security requirements and technical dependencies are identified, assigned, sequenced, and delivered throughout the migration.

This is a hands-on technical program leadership position requiring strong cybersecurity knowledge, technical fluency, and experience navigating complex enterprise environments. This is not a traditional PMO or status-reporting role.

This position is remote, with a strong preference for candidates located near Brooklyn Park, MN

Job Description

As a Technical Program Manager, you will provide end-to-end cybersecurity program coordination for a complex enterprise data platform migration. You will bring structure, visibility, and accountability to work spanning multiple technical teams while proactively identifying dependencies, risks, blockers, and decisions that could impact key migration milestones.

The ideal candidate is a technically fluent program leader who can participate credibly in cybersecurity and engineering discussions, translate technical considerations into actionable program plans, and drive cross-functional teams toward decisions and successful delivery.

Key Responsibilities Include

Drive end-to-end cybersecurity program coordination for an enterprise data platform migration.
Establish and maintain an integrated view of cybersecurity requirements, dependencies, milestones, ownership, sequencing, risks, and critical-path activities.
Identify security and technical dependencies early and ensure they have clear owners, delivery dates, and resolution plans.
Coordinate across Cybersecurity, Architecture, Engineering, Data and Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, and other enterprise teams.
Facilitate technical discussions to resolve security architecture, integration, dependency, sequencing, and ownership issues.
Identify gaps, conflicting assumptions, unresolved decisions, and delivery risks before they impact migration milestones.
Drive decisions and accountability when ownership or dependencies cross organizational boundaries.
Maintain clear visibility into critical dependencies, blockers, risks, decisions, milestones, and overall program health.
Provide concise, executive-level reporting focused on outcomes, risks, dependencies, decisions, and required actions.
Bring structure and accountability to complex, cross-functional initiatives and follow through on critical work through completion.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

10+ years of Technical Program Management or equivalent technical program leadership experience, preferably within large enterprise environments.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional technology programs involving multiple engineering and cybersecurity teams.
Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity domains, practices, and controls.
Experience coordinating security requirements and dependencies across areas such as:
Identity and Access Management (IAM)
Data security
Network security
Cloud security
Application and platform security
Vulnerability management
Logging and monitoring
Security architecture

Proven ability to manage complex technical dependencies, integration points, sequencing, critical paths, risks, and blockers across multiple teams.
Technical fluency sufficient to participate in architecture and engineering discussions, identify dependencies, challenge assumptions, surface gaps, and recognize delivery risks.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate program health, critical dependencies, risks, decisions, and required actions.
Ability to navigate organizational complexity, establish accountability, and drive decisions across teams with different priorities and ownership structures.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience supporting large-scale enterprise data platform migrations or modernization initiatives.
Experience working across cybersecurity, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, data, platform, and product organizations.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our healthcare system is the leading cause of personal bankruptcy in the U.S. Every year, over 50 million Americans suffer adverse financial consequences as a result of seeking care, from lower credit scores to garnished wages. The challenge is only getting worse, as high deductible health plans are the fastest growing plan design in the U.S.
Cedar’s mission is to leverage data science, smart product design and personalization to make healthcare more affordable and accessible. Today, healthcare providers still engage with its consumers in a “one-size-fits-all” approach; and Cedar is excited to leverage consumer best practices to deliver a superior experience.
Cedar is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the Makers Strategy & Operations team. This role is not aligned to a single product line or pillar, rather it is deployed against the most technically complex programs across the R&D organization. The efforts that span multiple teams, carry meaningful architectural risk, and lack clear end-to-end ownership at the outset.
The types of programs this person will take on are both architectural and product forward. Some will be multi-quarter platform, infrastructure, and data programs that touch how our systems are structured and how our products are built on top of them. Others will be product and feature programs, when they are demanding enough to warrant dedicated program leadership. In both cases, the programs carry real technical risk and dependencies that reach across the engineering organization. Cedar makes these investments to unlock the next generation of our product portfolio, to reduce the maintenance burden that accumulates in mature systems, and to build the foundations that make future products faster and cheaper to deliver. Work at this altitude is consequential to the trajectory of the business, and it carries visibility to match. The progress you make will be reviewed by executive leadership, and the outcomes will shape what Cedar is able to build for years afterward.
A defining characteristic of these programs is that they are under-defined when they begin. Requirements are incomplete, dependencies are undocumented, and the sequencing has not been worked out. The person in this role is expected to resolve that ambiguity, establish what is actually being built, in what order, with what tradeoffs, against what definition of done, and to remain accountable for delivery through to completion.
This is a senior individual contributor role with substantial exposure to engineering, product, and executive leadership. Success is measured by whether the hardest programs at Cedar land as intended. And, when they don't, by whether you saw it first. Stopping a program early because the underlying assumption turned out to be wrong, or catching a dependency in month two that would have surfaced in month six, is a good outcome. Delivering on time matters. So does the truth arriving early enough to act on.
Core Responsibilities
Own end-to-end delivery of the most complex technical programs across R&D: scope, sequencing, dependencies, risk, and the decision log
Break large architectural initiatives into sequenced milestones with explicit entry and exit criteria, then hold teams to them across planning cycles
Drive technical decisions to closure: surface the tradeoffs, force the choice, document what was decided and why it was decided that way
Manage dependencies across engineering teams and with Security, Infrastructure, Data, and client-facing functions
Provide program leadership where there is no dedicated PM, including writing the requirements when the requirements don't exist yet
Improve delivery predictability across the org: instrument delivery metrics, track technical debt, diagnose why programs slip, and fix the cause rather than the symptom
Give executives an unvarnished read on program state: what's true, what's at risk, and what decision is needed from them

Required Qualifications
8+ years in technical program management, with the majority of that time on platform, infrastructure, or data programs rather than feature delivery
Track record leading multi-team programs with genuine technical complexity: migrations, re-architectures, data platform builds, system consolidations
Ability to read a design doc, hold your own in an architecture review, and spot risk the engineers haven't flagged yet
Comfort operating as the only non-engineer in the room, and being the person accountable when the program is off track
Experience with programs where the problem is ambiguous and the first deliverable is a clear definition of what's actually being built
Working fluency in modern cloud and data architecture: warehouses, pipelines, service boundaries: enough to reason about tradeoffs independently
Strong technical writing: decision docs, program narratives, executive updates that don't require a translation layer
Experience using delivery metrics (DORA or equivalent) to change team behavior, not just to report status

Preferred Qualifications
Prior hands-on engineering experience, or a CS or related technical degree
SQL proficiency and the habit of pulling your own data
Experience in healthcare or another regulated domain where compliance requirements shape technical architecture
Experience with AI or ML platform programs
Background in high-growth environments where the process doesn't exist until you build it

Compensation Range and Benefits

Salary Range: $161,500 - $190,000
This role is equity eligible
This role offers a competitive benefits and wellness package
New York City preferred. Remote eligible.

*Subject to location, experience, and education

Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. Nava is seeking a Senior Program Manager (ISSO) to lead system security, risk management, and infrastructure oversight in support of the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).

In this role, you'll lead Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities, maintain the system's Authorization to Operate (ATO), oversee security controls and risk assessments, support continuous monitoring and incident response, and serve as a trusted advisor to CMS stakeholders on the program's overall security and privacy posture.

The ideal candidate will have a bachelor's degree and at least seven years of relevant experience, with a strong background in the Risk Management Framework (RMF), Authorization to Operate (ATO) management, cybersecurity, and federal compliance. Experience leading security assessments, managing POA&Ms, and implementing federal security controls in an operational environment is essential. While Nava and CMS provide onboarding through the ISSO Handbook and ISSO Boot Camp, candidates should bring established experience managing RMF activities and supporting federal information security programs. Although no specific certification is required under the contract, credentials such as CISSP, CISM, or CompTIA Security+ are highly desirable.

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible leadership role supporting one of CMS's mission-critical systems. You'll work closely with engineering teams, program leadership, and federal stakeholders to strengthen the program's security posture while helping deliver secure, reliable digital services that support millions of Americans.

Serve as the principal advisor to the Program ISSO involving the security and privacy of an information system
Be responsible for ensuring the implementation and maintenance of security and privacy controls in accordance with existing agency
Department, and federal government policies, as applicable
Provide guidance, oversight, and expertise to the development of security documents and implementation of security and privacy controls

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

5+ years of experience in related field.
In lieu of degree, 7+ years of experience in related field.

Two Sigma is a leading quantitative investment management and trading firm. The company applies a scientific approach to investing, combining cutting-edge technology, artificial intelligence, data science, and quantitative research with rigorous human inquiry to capitalize on market opportunities and deliver alpha for investors.

Partner with knowledge holders to capture tacit expertise

BS or equivalent work experience in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math (an MS is a plus)
Experience designing and delivering technical education or training programs
Strong communication skills with ability to translate complex concepts for varied audiences

jobs.title: Financial IT Project Manager (5670)
jobs.description:
SMX is seeking a dynamic and experienced Project Manager
to lead the implementation of our CFO Control Tower Budget and Spend (BAS) solution for a key federal government client. This role requires a leader who can expertly navigate the complexities of federal financial management projects, ensuring the successful deployment of a cutting-edge planning and reporting tool built on the SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) platform.
This is a unique and exciting role that allows the right candidate to use their deep understanding of federal budgeting and planning processes to help build our next generation planning application.  We are looking for an energetic and creative federal financial business analyst to take our solution to the next level and drive value for our federal customers.  You will be working alongside a talented team of designers, developers and budget SMEs to help build, enhance, and roll out our best-in-class solution.  This is a full-time position that is 100% remote and will require minimal travel <20% and requires a Public Trust clearance.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

The ideal candidate will be responsible for the entire project lifecycle, from planning and execution to stakeholder management and final delivery. You will serve as the primary point of contact for the client, ensuring that our "Shared Vision. Outcome Assured." motto is realized through meticulous planning, clear communication, and a relentless focus on achieving mission objectives.

Key Responsibilities

•    Project Leadership: Direct and manage the full lifecycle of the CFO Control Tower BAS implementation project, including scope, schedule, budget, and quality, from initiation to closure.
•    Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary liaison between federal client stakeholders, SMX technical teams, and third-party vendors to ensure clear communication and alignment of project goals.
•    Planning & Execution: Develop and maintain a comprehensive project plan, outlining tasks, timelines, resource allocation, and dependencies. Proactively manage risks and develop mitigation strategies.
•    Technical Oversight: While not a hands-on technical role, maintain a strong understanding of the SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) platform and the functional aspects of the BAS solution to guide the project effectively.
•    Team Coordination: Lead a cross-functional team of business analysts, data engineers, and solution architects, fostering a collaborative environment to break down stovepipes and deliver targeted capabilities.
•    Reporting & Governance: Provide regular, transparent status reports on project progress, risks, and financial health to both client leadership and SMX executive management.
•    Quality Assurance: Ensure the final solution meets all client requirements, is delivered on time, within budget, and adheres to the highest standards of quality and federal security protocols.
Required Skills & Experience:

•    Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field.
•    Minimum of 10 years’ experience as a Project Manager leading complex IT or financial system implementations.
•    Proven experience managing SAP ERP implementation and upgrade projects, demonstrating strong project management skills and a deep understanding of SAP systems.
•    Demonstrated experience managing projects for U.S. Federal Government agencies.
•    Strong understanding of the project management lifecycle and methodologies (e.g., PMP, Agile, Hybrid).
•    Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage and influence diverse stakeholder groups.
•    Must be a US Citizen and have the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.
Desired Skills & Experience

•    Experience in managing an SAP ERP or SAP EPM project is highly desirable.
•    PMP Certification is highly desired.
•    Direct experience with SAP solutions, particularly SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) for planning and reporting.
•    Familiarity with federal budgeting, financial planning, and reporting processes (e.g., PPBE).
•    Previous experience implementing COTS (Commercial Off-The-Shelf) or pre-built software solutions.
•    Experience managing projects with a significant data integration or business intelligence component.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Enterprise Growth & Capital Programs
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Senior Program Manager – is responsible for the end‑to‑end delivery of enterprise‑level growth programs, including new site builds, site expansions, and facilities readiness required to meet committed product launch timelines.

This role owns programs from requirements definition through site launch and operational handoff, working backwards from target launch dates to ensure facilities, infrastructure, resources, and cross‑functional capabilities are fully aligned. The Program Manager acts as the single point of accountability and applies Project Management Institute (PMI) standards to ensure disciplined planning, execution, and delivery across multiple complex programs.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Definition & Customer Alignment

Ensure all project requirements, objectives, and customer needs (internal and/or external) are clearly gathered, understood, and translated into executable plans
Collaborate with customers and business units from requirements gathering through product acceptance and site launch
Align program teams to customer and business needs by establishing clear milestones, goals, and objectives informed by all functional stakeholders
Devise creative and practical solutions to critical customer, user, and business requirements

Program Planning, Controls & Execution (PMI
‑Based)

Develop and manage integrated program plans using PMI standards, covering scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and change management
Coordinate with functional project managers and project coordinators to review and integrate detailed project schedules
Manage execution of tasks to completion in accordance with approved schedules and baselines
Maintain accountability for overall project success, balancing cost, schedule, scope, and quality against enterprise requirements

Cross
‑Functional & Enterprise Leadership

Build, lead, and motivate cross‑functional teams to deliver multiple and/or enterprise‑level programs, including:
Facilities & Engineering
Manufacturing & Operations
IT / Systems
Supply Chain & Procurement
Finance
Legal
Human Resources
Business Units / Commercial
Serve as the primary interface with customers, vendors, stakeholders, and project sponsors
Communicate program objectives in the context of overall strategic business goals
Provide guidance, coaching, and motivation to teams through complex and high‑pressure delivery environments

Financial, Resource & KPI Management

Perform financial management and cost analysis, including:
Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs)
Resource allocation
Travel, training, and other program‑related costs

Forecast project budgets and labor requirements to support current and future site needs
Manage resource capacity and time tracking across enterprise‑level programs
Define, monitor, and manage project‑specific KPIs, ensuring work is delivered within scope, time, cost, and quality constraints

Risk, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Develop integrated risk analyses with actionable mitigation plans
Identify potential problem areas early and implement alternative solutions as needed
Obtain, analyze, and summarize program status versus performance baselines
Report program status, issues, outcomes, and implemented solutions to leadership
Provide leaders with clear insights into risks, opportunities, and improvement areas
Identify and implement cost‑reduction opportunities through process optimization and system improvements
Drive continuous improvement through metrics management, trend analysis, and best‑practice sharing across sites and teams

Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

Deliver clear, concise, and effective communication through a variety of channels
Design consistent, audience‑appropriate messaging for diverse stakeholder groups
Work closely with communications, stakeholders, and leadership to evaluate and measure program effectiveness and business impact
Design and facilitate training related to enterprise initiatives and program implementation
Demonstrate strong customer focus by anticipating needs, resolving issues quickly, and coaching others through complex decision‑making situations

Compliance & Additional Responsibilities

Comply with all company security policies, procedures, and governance requirements
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

Required

8+ years of experience leading complex, cross‑functional, enterprise‑level programs
Proven experience delivering facilities‑driven or capital‑intensive initiatives (site builds, expansions, infrastructure programs)
Strong ability to translate requirements into executable plans and drive delivery across matrixed teams
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification – required
Demonstrated expertise applying PMI standards and methodologies across the full project lifecycle
Experience supporting product launches or large‑scale growth initiatives
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills

Why This Role Matters

This role ensures growth programs are delivered with clarity, discipline, and predictability, enabling sites to be stood up and products launched in alignment with business and customer commitments—while maintaining rigorous cost, schedule, and quality control.

• Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Backlog Refinement and Retrospectives.

About The Role

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager for a leading enterprise organization operating in the retail industry. This role will support a large-scale enterprise data platform migration, with a primary focus on coordinating cybersecurity requirements, technical dependencies, and execution across multiple technology teams.

The Technical Program Manager will work closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, Architecture, Data and Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, and Product teams to ensure security requirements and technical dependencies are identified, assigned, sequenced, and delivered throughout the migration.

This is a hands-on technical program leadership position requiring strong cybersecurity knowledge, technical fluency, and experience navigating complex enterprise environments. This is not a traditional PMO or status-reporting role.

Job Description

As a Technical Program Manager, you will provide end-to-end cybersecurity program coordination for a complex enterprise data platform migration. You will bring structure, visibility, and accountability to work spanning multiple technical teams while proactively identifying dependencies, risks, blockers, and decisions that could impact key migration milestones.

The ideal candidate is a technically fluent program leader who can participate credibly in cybersecurity and engineering discussions, translate technical considerations into actionable program plans, and drive cross-functional teams toward decisions and successful delivery.

Key Responsibilities Include

Drive end-to-end cybersecurity program coordination for an enterprise data platform migration.
Establish and maintain an integrated view of cybersecurity requirements, dependencies, milestones, ownership, sequencing, risks, and critical-path activities.
Identify security and technical dependencies early and ensure they have clear owners, delivery dates, and resolution plans.
Coordinate across Cybersecurity, Architecture, Engineering, Data and Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, and other enterprise teams.
Facilitate technical discussions to resolve security architecture, integration, dependency, sequencing, and ownership issues.
Identify gaps, conflicting assumptions, unresolved decisions, and delivery risks before they impact migration milestones.
Drive decisions and accountability when ownership or dependencies cross organizational boundaries.
Maintain clear visibility into critical dependencies, blockers, risks, decisions, milestones, and overall program health.
Provide concise, executive-level reporting focused on outcomes, risks, dependencies, decisions, and required actions.
Bring structure and accountability to complex, cross-functional initiatives and follow through on critical work through completion.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

10+ years of Technical Program Management or equivalent technical program leadership experience, preferably within large enterprise environments.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional technology programs involving multiple engineering and cybersecurity teams.
Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity domains, practices, and controls.
Experience coordinating security requirements and dependencies across areas such as:
Identity and Access Management (IAM)
Data security
Network security
Cloud security
Application and platform security
Vulnerability management
Logging and monitoring
Security architecture

Proven ability to manage complex technical dependencies, integration points, sequencing, critical paths, risks, and blockers across multiple teams.
Technical fluency sufficient to participate in architecture and engineering discussions, identify dependencies, challenge assumptions, surface gaps, and recognize delivery risks.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate program health, critical dependencies, risks, decisions, and required actions.
Ability to navigate organizational complexity, establish accountability, and drive decisions across teams with different priorities and ownership structures.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience supporting large-scale enterprise data platform migrations or modernization initiatives.
Experience working across cybersecurity, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, data, platform, and product organizations.
Experience operating in a large-scale retail or similarly complex enterprise technology environment.
Experience working directly with security architects, engineers, technical leaders, and senior executives.
Ability to translate complex technical and cybersecurity topics into clear program-level risks, dependencies, decisions, and actions.

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-09-29 11:59 PM

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Your Role

CBC/Radio-Canada is seeking a Lead Analyst, Data Protection Specialist, to design, lead and evolve the Corporation’s data security program.

In this role, you will provide technical and operational leadership to safeguard sensitive data and personal information throughout the data life cycle (collection, processing, storage, transmission, archiving and destruction). You will collaborate closely with Legal Services, privacy officers, enterprise architects and IT Operations to align data security with regulatory requirements and industry standards.

This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.

What’s In It For You

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.

As Lead Analyst, you will:

Define data security strategy: Develop and refine the road map for the Corporation’s data protection program.
Implement data classification: Establish and deploy data classification policies and frameworks.
Administer data protection technologies: Select, deploy and optimize data loss prevention (DLP) tools.
Protect cloud and hybrid environments: Design security controls tailored to cloud-hosted data and hybrid architectures.
Partner on compliance and policy frameworks: Work closely with the policy, compliance and legal affairs lead to align security controls with statutory requirements.
Manage the data security risk register: Document, maintain and map risks related to confidentiality, potential data breaches and approved exceptions.
Adjudicate and govern exception requests: Evaluate, document and follow up on exception requests when standard security controls cannot be immediately applied, ensuring appropriate compensating controls are established.
Lead data breach response: Actively participate in investigations of suspected or confirmed data breaches in co-ordination with the Information Security, Legal Services and Incident Response teams.
Develop metrics and dashboards: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to monitor program effectiveness.
Assess program maturity: Plan and conduct periodic evaluations, performance reviews and audits of data protection controls to identify gaps, measure maturity progress and formulate recommendations for continuous improvement.
Maintain industry expertise: Stay current on information security best practices and industry trends.

What You Bring

University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
Minimum five years’ experience in data protection, privacy security, DLP or data governance, including at least three years in an information security role.
Proven track record of implementing and evaluating technical data protection programs within large, complex organizations.
Deep technical expertise in data protection, including cryptography (encryption at rest and in transit, PKI), DLP tools (network, endpoint, cloud), CASB technologies and SQL/NoSQL databases.
Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical decision-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities.
Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
Technical expertise across key domains:
Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-161, COBIT and ITIL.
Cloud and Web Architecture Security: Solid understanding of web infrastructure and cloud environment security.
Network and Security Technologies: Thorough understanding of network architectures (LAN/WAN, routers), network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, DNS, web filtering) and cryptographic principles (encryption at rest and in transit).
Architecture and Data Security: Working knowledge of database architecture concepts and secure software development best practices.
Operational Resilience and Physical Security: Solid understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning (BCP/DRP), operational resilience and physical security controls.

Relevant professional security certifications a definite asset (e.g., CISSP, CRISC, CBCP, CISA, CISM or equivalent).
Bilingualism (English and French) essential.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:

Build effective partnerships with executive sponsors, business owners, Compliance, Technology, Business Lines, Corporate Functions, delivery partners, and vendors.

Communicate complex delivery information clearly for both working teams and senior audiences.
Promote a collaborative, inclusive, accountable, and outcome-focused team environment.
Contribute ideas that improve delivery effectiveness, reporting, governance, tooling, and ways of working.

Demonstrated experience delivering medium-to-high complexity initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, workstreams, and dependencies.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency with a distributed team across the U.S., Canada, Europe and Latin America. We provide beginning-to-end strategy, design and production services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

We’re hiring our first Business Operations Manager. You’ll own sales operations and finance administration day-to-day: pipeline hygiene, proposals, invoicing, contracts, payroll prep, the tools that hold it together. 

This role rewards people who notice the thing everyone else missed: the invoice with last month’s rate, the deal with no next step, the proposal PDF with a broken link. If that describes you, and you’ve run operations at an agency or professional services firm before, keep reading.

You’re also AI-forward without being AI-dazzled. Most of our repeatable work is documented as playbooks, and Claude produces the first draft: proposals, call briefs, invoices, month-end prep. You have to be the review gate, nothing leaves the mailbox without a human who has actually read it. You’ll work closely with founders and the leadership team.

Key Responsibilities

Sales operations

Keep CRM accurate: every deal has a stage, an owner, a next step and a date, reviewed weekly
Review sales calls and turn them into proposals
Assemble proposals from our templates once scope, pricing, and timeline are set by the Account and Project Manager: pricing tab, portfolio links, PDF check, DocuSign envelope
Chase signatures and hand closed deals into onboarding with a complete client record
Keep the pricing file, proposal templates, reference list, and portfolio index current
Prepare pre-call notes for every new-business call
Send a weekly business health report covering prospect status, stalled deals and follow-up reminders
Flag upcoming retainer expirations, renewals and needed change orders

Finance administration

Invoicing and accounts receivable follow-up in QuickBooks
Bookkeeper liaison and month-end prep
Vendors, subscriptions and expense approvals
Payroll prep and contractor payments
First pass on the monthly financial review

Systems and playbooks

Monday.com and Google Drive hygiene
Update the playbook when a process changes, and publish it where the team can find it
Queue tomorrow’s automated tasks in the evening and review what ran in the morning
Build and improve automations in Make, Monday.com, and Claude that other people actually use

People operations (light)

Contractor agreements through DocuSign
Onboarding and offboarding checklists
Studio management

Requirements

5+ years in operations, revenue operations, or finance administration at a marketing, digital, or creative agency, studio, or professional services firm
Hands-on experience running a sales pipeline in a CRM and handling invoicing and receivables in a bookkeeping tool
Exceptional attention to detail with numbers, names and dates: you check before you send, without being asked
Daily use of AI tools, at least one workflow you built for yourself
Strong writer in English: proposals, invoices, and client emails go out in your words after founder approval, and tone matters as much as correctness. Fluent spoken English for calls
Comfortable in a fully remote team
Based in Brazil, with at least 4 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours

Our Stack
You’ll work in HubSpot, QuickBooks, Monday.com, Docusign, Rippling, Fathom, Make, Google Workspace and Slack, with Claude as the drafting layer across all of it. Direct experience with Monday.com and QuickBooks is strongly preferred. You can learn the rest on the job if you’ve used comparable tools.

Strong Bonus
You’ve supported a U.S. company from Brazil or elsewhere in Latin America
Exposure to U.S. bookkeeping or payroll
You’ve built automations others adopted, in Make, Zapier or comparable
Familiarity with CLI-based AI tools (Claude Code or similar) and MCP connectors
You’ve run a process handover: written something down well enough that someone else did it without you

The Perks
Diverse team based in the U.S., U.K., Europe, Canada and Latin America
Interesting clients in the technology space, and real ownership of how the agency runs
Fully remote
A highly cooperative, low-ego team that encourages professional growth and self-development

We are seeking a highly motivated and customer-focused Implementation Manager / Project Manager / Business Analyst to join our growing team.

The ideal candidate combines the communication skills of a consultant, the organization of a project manager, and the analytical thinking of a business analyst.

This individual will play a critical role in leading customer implementations, gathering and documenting business requirements, coordinating project activities, and ensuring customers achieve measurable business value from the TranscendAP platform.

Position Summary

As an Implementation Manager / Project Manager / Business Analyst, you will serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise customers throughout the implementation lifecycle. You will work closely with customer stakeholders, executive sponsors, product management, development teams, and support organizations to successfully deploy and optimize TranscendAP solutions.

You will be responsible for managing project plans, facilitating workshops, documenting requirements, coordinating integrations, mitigating risks, and driving customer adoption. This role requires strong business acumen, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to evaluate complex business challenges, facilitate stakeholder alignment, and define requirements that support scalable and efficient business solutions

This position is primarily remote.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Implementation Leadership

Lead end-to-end software implementation projects from kickoff through go-live and post-production support.
Serve as the primary customer-facing project lead throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Facilitate project kickoff meetings, requirements workshops, status meetings, executive reviews, and training sessions.
Develop and maintain implementation project plans, timelines, milestones, and resource schedules.
Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and escalation processes.

Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from customer stakeholders.
Translate business requirements into functional specifications and technical requirements.
Evaluate customer business processes and recommend workflow improvements and automation opportunities.
Map customer requirements to TranscendAP product capabilities and identify configuration or enhancement needs.
Create process flows, requirements documents, use cases, and implementation documentation.

Solution Design & Integration Management

Define integration requirements with ERP, Procurement, Financial, and other enterprise systems.
Collaborate with technical teams to design and validate integration mappings and business rules.
Assist customers with solution configuration and deployment planning.
Support testing activities including system testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and go-live readiness reviews.

Customer Success & Communication

Build trusted relationships with customer executives, project sponsors, administrators, and end users.
Provide regular project status updates and executive-level communications.
Create professional project documentation, meeting notes, training materials, and implementation deliverables.
Ensure successful user adoption through training, coaching, and change management activities.
Support customers post-implementation to maximize product value and adoption.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Product Management, Development, QA, Professional Services, and Customer Support teams.
Collect customer feedback and enhancement requests and communicate them effectively to internal stakeholders.
Participate in product improvement initiatives based on customer experiences and market needs.
Maintain internal project dashboards, implementation metrics, and customer reporting.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
5+ years of experience managing software implementation projects.
3+ years of business analysis and requirements gathering experience.
3+ years of customer-facing experience in a software or SaaS environment.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects.
Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities.
Experience leading customer meetings and executive presentations.
Ability to create professional documentation and customer deliverables.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to customer success.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Accounts Payable Automation solutions.
Experience with ERP platforms such as Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Quickbooks, Ellucian Banner, PeopleSoft, or similar systems.
Experience with workflow automation and business process optimization.
Experience with SaaS software implementations.
Experience with Procurement, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing, or Financial Operations processes.
Experience with OCR, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), AI-powered automation, or invoice capture technologies.
Experience working in enterprise software consulting or professional services organizations.

Soft Skills

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
Confidence interacting with executives and senior business leaders.
Strong meeting facilitation and presentation abilities.
Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
Customer-first mindset.
Strong ownership and accountability.
Collaborative team-oriented approach.
Positive attitude and willingness to solve complex problems.
Ability to remain organized and effective in a fast-paced environment.
Strong listening and relationship-building skills.

Success Metrics - What Success Looks Like After 12 Months

Within the first year, the successful candidate will:

Successfully lead multiple customer implementations from kickoff through production deployment.
Consistently deliver projects on time and within agreed scope.
Maintain high customer satisfaction scores and positive customer feedback.
Become a trusted advisor to key customer stakeholders.
Improve implementation efficiency through process improvements and best practices.
Produce high-quality requirements documentation and project deliverables.
Contribute meaningful product enhancement recommendations based on customer feedback.
Support increased customer adoption and expansion opportunities.
Develop expertise in TranscendAP's platform, integrations, and AP automation processes.
Become a key contributor to the continued growth and success of the Professional Services organization.

Why Join TranscendAP?

Opportunity to directly influence product direction and customer success.
Collaborative culture focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Responsable Déploiement / Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations

Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins.

L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Nous accompagnons chaque hôpital de A à Z dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration.

Notre équipe est composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, tous pilotés par Loïc, notre Lead Customer Operations.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

En tant qu'Operations Manager, tu seras au cœur du déploiement de nos solutions dans les établissements de santé :

Cadrage projet :
organiser et animer les réunions de cadrage avec les établissements pour comprendre leurs besoins techniques et fonctionnels, et définir la meilleure intégration de nos solutions dans leur quotidien ; adapter ton discours selon tes interlocuteurs (responsables IT, chefs de projet, utilisateurs terrain).

Accompagnement fonctionnel :
comprendre l'organisation des services hospitaliers et les parcours patients pour adapter nos solutions aux réalités terrain ; challenger les besoins clients et proposer les meilleures pratiques.

Déploiement technique :
configurer nos applications et flux d'interopérabilité (HL7), orchestrer les échanges avec les équipes IT des hôpitaux ; maîtriser les aspects réseau, serveurs Windows, déploiement applicatif et sécurité.

Recette & résolution :
vérifier le bon fonctionnement de bout en bout avec les clients, diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes techniques ; qualifier les bugs et faire remonter les demandes d'évolution à l’équipe produit avec clarté et conviction.

Support expert :
assurer le support niveau 2 en faisant le pont entre le support niveau 1 et la R&D ; monitorer proactivement les flux et certificats pour anticiper les incidents.

Amélioration continue :
participer activement à l'optimisation de nos process internes et contribuer à des projets transverses ; partager tes retours terrain pour faire évoluer nos produits et nos méthodes.

Polyvalence produit :
intervenir sur l'ensemble de nos solutions et développer une véritable expertise transverse.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Expérience en déploiement de projets à l'hôpital ou en healthtech avec déploiement hospitalier
: Tu connais le monde hospitalier, son fonctionnement, ses contraintes.

Excellent communicant
: Tu es à l'aise pour échanger avec différents interlocuteurs (IT, chefs de projet, utilisateurs), tu sais vulgariser et adapter ton discours.

Mindset doer
: Tu n'as pas peur de mettre les mains dans le cambouis et d’être au coeur de l’opérationnel.

Autonome et proactif
: Tu anticipes les problèmes, tu remontes rapidement les blocages, tu es force de proposition.

Compétences techniques (nice to have)
: Connaissance en administration système (Windows Server, GPO), réseau (SFTP, VPN) et/ou interopérabilité HL7. Si tu viens de l'hôpital sans ces compétences, pas de problème, elles s'apprennent !

Passion pour la santé
: Tu as un intérêt pour améliorer la qualité des soins et la vie des soignants.

💎 Nos avantages

Mode de travail : Commuter (3 jours/semaine au bureau)
Une carte Swile avec 9€/jour (50% Lifen)
Une mutuelle santé incluant médecine alternative et soutien en santé mentale (55% Lifen)
30€/mois pour concerts, musées ou même pour rembourser ton abonnement Spotify
Une prise en charge à 100% du congé maternité et paternité + 5 jours enfants malades par an
1 offsite avec ton équipe par semestre + 1 offsite global Lifen par an + 1 monthly où nous nous retrouvons tous au bureau à Paris
Et enfin : une politique de rémunération transparente et graduelle

👥 Notre process de recrutement

Premier échange RH avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager (30 minutes);
Entretien manager avec Loïc (45 minutes);
Cas pratique à préparer chez soi, puis restitution et discussion avec l'équipe dans nos locaux (1 heure);
Entretien final avec deux Lifeners d'une autre équipe;

Soigner mieux en soignant ensemble, c'est aussi agir avec bienveillance. À l'image du secteur dans lequel nous évoluons, nous favorisons la diversité, l'inclusion et l'équité. Nous mettons en valeur vos compétences et votre savoir-faire, et bannissons toute forme de discrimination, qu'elle soit sexuelle, religieuse ou politique.

Compensation Range: €40K - €50K

What We're Looking For

HNTB is seeking a dynamic and entrepreneurial traffic engineering leader who is eager to help build a growing team across Northern New England while leading impactful transportation projects throughout the region. In the near term, you'll lead a diverse portfolio of traffic engineering projects from our South Portland, ME, or Bedford, NH, offices. Working with clients such as MaineDOT, NHDOT, VTrans, and HNTB's oldest client, the Maine Turnpike Authority, you'll help deliver a wide range of services, from planning and traffic studies to traffic signal and ITS engineering, microsimulation, and real-time operational strategies.

In this role, you'll manage projects through their full lifecycle, from shaping proposals and negotiating contracts to delivering on HNTB's 4-for-4 performance promise: quality work, on time, on budget, and to the client's satisfaction. You'll collaborate with internal and external partners, solve complex transportation challenges, and ensure successful outcomes on projects that make a lasting impact. This role places you at the forefront of innovation, helping guide teams and clients toward smarter, safer, and more connected mobility solutions.

Beyond project delivery, you'll also play a key role in strengthening client relationships, recruiting and developing talent, expanding our market presence, and helping define the future of traffic engineering services across Maine, New Hampshire, and Vermont. As part of a nationally recognized transportation practice, you'll collaborate with regional and national leaders to deliver innovative solutions while helping grow HNTB's presence throughout Northern New England. With more than a century of experience delivering some of the nation's most complex transportation infrastructure projects, HNTB offers the unique opportunity to combine the impact of building a growing regional practice with the resources, expertise, and stability of an established employee-owned firm.

Partners with Client Service Leaders and pursuit champions to assist with business development, building client relationships, and pursuit efforts for strategic and mini-mega projects in accordance with HNTB's Sophisticated Sales Approach (SSA). At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.

The Investigative / Intelligence analyst will apply project management, open-source research, behavioral threat assessment and management, threat assessment, and Program legal and policy guidance, together with strong writing and editing skills, to support longer-term research, production, field support, investigations and office improvement initiatives. The Analyst is expected to work autonomously, contributing meaningfully to initiatives even in the absence of clear tasking, and must maintain a high degree of organization across concurrent responsibilities. Strong written communication is essential: the Analyst must write clearly and concisely in accordance with approved Program templates and style guides and must be able to edit products drafted by other personnel to ensure quality and consistency. The Analyst will advise the government on the status of current initiatives and recommend new or improved approaches where appropriate. Responsibilities/Duties:

Monitor Classified Intelligence.
Continuously review and research classified cable traffic and other intelligence reporting to identify potential direct and indirect threats relevant to U.S. diplomatic facilities and personnel, as well as to other U.S. interests overseas. Evaluate Dissemination Criteria.

Databases and Information Logging.

Manage Workload. 
Operate autonomously, managing time effectively while adhering to established processes and procedures

Collaborate with Stakeholders.
Work closely with colleagues and organizational partners to obtain and share security-related intelligence, ensuring timely awareness of relevant threat reporting.

Bachelor's degree plus 5 years of relevant experience

Required Skills

Prior experience monitoring, researching, and disseminating security and/or threat-related intelligence reporting, particularly in a U.S. government or Department of State context

Strong ability to identify relevant intelligence and generate accurate, timely, concise synopses of reports

Ability to follow established processes, procedures, and written templates

Strong skills in oral and written communication to present clear, concise information overviews

Strong interpersonal skills, capable of working effectively with internal and external stakeholders

Highly collaborative, with the ability to interact effectively and professionally with individuals at all levels

Customer service mindset, with a strong desire to meet customer needs within established mission parameters

At TSB, you’ll be part of a profit for purpose organisation, that empowers and enables you to be your best and make a positive difference for the people you work with, and the communities you are part of.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) professional to strengthen TSB’s financial crime intelligence capability.

This role focuses on thematic reviews, strategic financial crime analysis and executive reporting. You will assess emerging risks and the effectiveness of TSB’s financial crime controls, turning complex information into clear findings and practical recommendations.

This is not an AML operations or alert investigation role.
It requires broader experience in financial crime risk, intelligence, assurance or advisory work.

Who are you?

You will bring deep AML/CFT knowledge, strong analytical judgement and the ability to assess complex financial crime risks across customers, products, channels and transactions.

You will be a confident report writer who can communicate complex issues clearly to senior leaders and governance forums. Banking experience is strongly preferred, along with an understanding of how regulatory obligations, financial crime controls and customer outcomes work together.

In this role, you can expect to:

Complete thematic reviews of financial crime risks, emerging typologies and control effectiveness.

Produce high-quality reports, executive briefings and governance papers with clear findings and practical recommendations.
Analyse internal data, regulatory guidance and industry intelligence to identify emerging risks and control gaps.
Support TSB’s financial crime risk assessments, Red Flag Library and transaction monitoring strategy.

We are looking for candidates who have:

Deep AML/CFT expertise, preferably gained within banking or another regulated financial institution.
Experience completing thematic reviews, financial crime risk assessments or control effectiveness reviews.
Strong executive writing skills and the ability to turn complex analysis into clear, evidence-based recommendations.
Broader strategic, intelligence or advisory experience beyond operational AML alert review and case investigation.

What’s in it for me?

At TSB, we’re small enough to genuinely care about our customers and big enough to offer innovative products and digital solutions. We are working towards being the easiest bank to deal with and are looking for people who can help us get there.

TSB is 100% owned by Toi Foundation, a philanthropic trust. Our annual dividends support Toi Foundation’s positive impact across our communities.

We believe everyone brings something unique to the workplace. We support our people to be themselves, look after their wellbeing and make a meaningful difference for customers, communities and Aotearoa.

jobs.description:
Nuova opportunità in AXA Partners Italy.

Unisciti a noi come Data Analyst e diventa una figura chiave nel nostro team IT, Data & AI di Roma. In questo ruolo dinamico avrai la straordinaria opportunità di trasformare dati complessi in insight fruibili, guidando decisioni strategiche e promuovendo l'innovazione in AXA Partners.

Cosa Farai

La tua missione sarà trasformare i dati in valore per il business, guidando l'intero ciclo di vita delle iniziative di Analytics e Data Science. Sarai responsabile della progettazione e dell'evoluzione di dashboard e reportistica avanzata, della generazione di insight strategici e dell'applicazione di tecniche analitiche evolute, incluse Machine Learning, modellazione predittiva e analisi delle serie temporali.

Lavorerai a stretto contatto con stakeholder nazionali e internazionali, comprendendone esigenze e obiettivi per tradurli in soluzioni data-driven ad alto impatto. Attraverso un'efficace combinazione di data visualization, storytelling e competenze analitiche, supporterai il processo decisionale, contribuendo concretamente alla crescita della cultura del dato e all'innovazione all'interno di AXA Partners.

Sarai Al Centro Della Nostra Strategia Dati, Contribuendo a

Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere dashboard, reportistica avanzata e analisi ad hoc, trasformando i dati in insight strategici a supporto dei processi decisionali aziendali.

Realizzare analisi approfondite sfruttando datamart, cubi analitici e fonti dati eterogenee, valorizzando tecniche di data visualization e data storytelling per favorire la comprensione e l'adozione degli insight.

Garantire l'affidabilità, la coerenza e la qualità dei dati attraverso attività di monitoraggio, validazione e gestione proattiva degli incidenti relativi agli strumenti e ai processi analitici.

Definire, implementare e promuovere standard metodologici, framework analitici e best practice per migliorare l'efficacia e la scalabilità delle soluzioni di analytics.

Contribuire alla diffusione di una cultura data-driven, condividendo competenze, supportando i team aziendali nell'interpretazione dei dati e favorendo l'adozione di approcci basati su evidenze quantitative.

Partecipare attivamente alle community e alle guild di Data & AI Analytics, contribuendo all'innovazione continua, alla sperimentazione di nuove tecnologie e alla crescita delle competenze interne.

Collaborare con stakeholder di business e team multidisciplinari lungo l'intero ciclo di vita delle iniziative data-driven, dall'identificazione delle esigenze fino al rilascio delle soluzioni analitiche e predittive.

Applicare tecniche avanzate di Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e analisi delle serie temporali per sviluppare modelli in grado di generare valore e supportare decisioni strategiche.

Industrializzare, distribuire e monitorare modelli e algoritmi in ambiente di produzione, garantendone performance, affidabilità e miglioramento continuo nel tempo.

Facilitare workshop e momenti di confronto interfunzionale, traducendo concetti tecnici complessi in raccomandazioni chiare e actionable per interlocutori non tecnici.

Sviluppare una profonda conoscenza del patrimonio informativo aziendale e dei processi di business, identificando opportunità di innovazione e assicurando l'integrazione efficace delle soluzioni dati all'interno dell'ecosistema AXA Partners.

Supportare la definizione di casi d'uso avanzati e la misurazione del valore generato dalle iniziative di Analytics e AI, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi strategici dell'organizzazione.

Cerchiamo Un/a Professionista Con

Esperienza e Formazione:

3-5+ anni di comprovata esperienza in un ruolo di Data Analyst, Data Scientist o simile ruolo quantitativo.
Laurea Magistrale in Informatica, Statistica, Matematica o Ingegneria.
Certificazioni preferenziali: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300), Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100), Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900), Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Data Engineering Solutions Using Azure Databricks (DP-750).

Competenze Tecniche Essenziali

Business Intelligence & Data Visualization: Elevata competenza nell'utilizzo di Power BI per la progettazione e lo sviluppo di dashboard interattive, reportistica avanzata e KPI framework. Solida esperienza nella modellazione dati, nell'ottimizzazione delle performance e nell'utilizzo di DAX per la costruzione di metriche complesse e analisi self-service orientate al business.
Data Science & Big Data Analytics: Esperienza pratica nell'utilizzo di Databricks per attività di data preparation, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering e sviluppo di modelli avanzati di Machine Learning su dataset di grandi dimensioni, sfruttando architetture distribuite e framework Big Data.
Cloud Data Platform & Data Engineering: Solida conoscenza dell'ecosistema dati Microsoft Azure, con esperienza nell'utilizzo di Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks e Unity Catalog per la gestione, l'orchestrazione, la governance e la valorizzazione del patrimonio informativo aziendale.
Programmazione e Advanced Analytics: Ottima padronanza di Python (Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, Scikit-learn), Scala e R per attività di analisi dati, automazione, modellazione statistica, Machine Learning e sviluppo di soluzioni data-driven scalabili ed efficienti.
Database Management & SQL: Competenze avanzate in SQL per interrogazione, trasformazione e ottimizzazione dei dati, con esperienza nella progettazione di query complesse, data modeling e gestione di ambienti relazionali e analitici ad alte prestazioni.
Version Control & Collaborative Development: Familiarità con Git e con le principali pratiche di versioning, collaborazione e gestione del ciclo di sviluppo del codice, a supporto di workflow strutturati e processi di delivery affidabili.
Data Architecture & Governance: Conoscenza delle principali tematiche di data governance, data quality, metadata management e data lineage, garantendo affidabilità, tracciabilità e conformità dei dati lungo l'intero ciclo di vita delle soluzioni analitiche.
End-to-End Analytics Delivery: Capacità di operare lungo l'intera catena del valore del dato, dalla raccolta e preparazione delle informazioni fino alla produzione di insight, dashboard e modelli predittivi, assicurando un approccio integrato tra Analytics, Data Engineering e Data Science.

Competenze Analitiche e Di Data Science

Modellazione Avanzata e Data Science: Solida preparazione statistica e consolidata esperienza nell'applicazione di tecniche di Machine Learning supervisionato e non supervisionato, incluse regressione, classificazione, clustering e segmentazione avanzata. Competenza nello sviluppo di modelli predittivi e nell'analisi di serie temporali, con particolare attenzione alla validazione, interpretabilità e generazione di valore per il business.
MLOps e Industrializzazione dei Modelli: Esperienza nell'implementazione e nella gestione del ciclo di vita delle soluzioni di Machine Learning, dalla prototipazione al rilascio in produzione. Conoscenza dei principi e delle pratiche MLOps, inclusi deployment, monitoraggio delle performance, gestione del drift dei modelli, automazione dei processi e manutenzione continua per garantire affidabilità, scalabilità e sostenibilità delle soluzioni AI.
Data Storytelling e Insight Communication: Comprovata capacità di trasformare analisi complesse e risultati quantitativi in insight chiari, significativi e orientati all'azione. Abilità nel combinare data visualization, storytelling e comprensione del contesto di business per supportare il processo decisionale e massimizzare l'impatto delle iniziative di Analytics e Data Science sugli stakeholder

Soft Skills

Comunicazione e Collaborazione: Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) e italiano (madrelingua), con comprovata abilità nel tradurre concetti tecnici complessi in messaggi chiari e orientati al business. Forte predisposizione alla collaborazione in contesti multidisciplinari, internazionali e multiculturali, favorendo l'allineamento tra funzioni tecniche e stakeholder di business.
Adattabilità e Resilienza: Capacità di operare con efficacia in ambienti dinamici e in continua evoluzione, gestendo simultaneamente priorità multiple, scadenze sfidanti e cambiamenti organizzativi. Approccio resiliente e orientato ai risultati, mantenendo elevati standard qualitativi anche in contesti ad alta pressione.
Proattività e Problem Solving: Spiccata attitudine proattiva e forte orientamento al problem solving, con capacità di anticipare esigenze, identificare opportunità di miglioramento e proporre soluzioni innovative basate sui dati. Consolidata esperienza nella gestione delle relazioni con stakeholder a diversi livelli organizzativi, bilanciando aspettative, obiettivi di business e vincoli tecnici. Elevato grado di autonomia, accountability e orientamento al raggiungimento dei risultati.
Pensiero Critico e Orientamento al Valore: Forte capacità analitica e di pensiero critico, con approccio strutturato alla risoluzione dei problemi e attenzione alla generazione di valore per il business attraverso insight data-driven e soluzioni innovative.

Cosa Offriamo

L'opportunità di entrare a far parte di un contesto internazionale, dinamico e orientato all'innovazione, dove il contributo individuale ha un impatto concreto sulle decisioni di business.

Un percorso di crescita professionale continuo, supportato da programmi di formazione, certificazioni, mentoring e confronto con professionisti del settore Data & AI.

jobs.title: Jr. SQL & Power BI Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description: Data Analyst SQL, Power BI & Advanced Excel (US Shift)

Required : Only Ahmedabad Based or Immediate Joiner Candidates (No relocation)

Location: Ahmedabad (on-site)

Shift: 6:30 PM 3:30 AM IST (8:00 AM 5:00 PM US Central; shifts by one hour with US daylight saving)

About Company:

Profusion Systems is a Chicago-based, AI-enabled custom software development company with an engineering team in Ahmedabad. We build production software and data-driven solutions for clients across fintech, nonprofit, food and facility services, and SaaS.
Our work includes AI and LLM integrations, Azure AI deployments, document automation, custom web and mobile applications, and business reporting solutions. We work closely with international clients, helping them turn business requirements into reliable, scalable technology.

About the role

You will work directly with a US-based client as their embedded reporting and analysis resource. This is not a back-office ticket queue you will talk to business stakeholders, understand what they actually need, and build the reporting that answers it. The work spans pulling data from multiple systems, analysing it, and delivering it as reports and dashboards people make decisions from.
We are looking for someone who is technically capable and comfortable in front of a client. Both matter equally.

What you'll do

Query data from multiple sources databases, exports, third-party systems and reconcile it into a single reliable dataset
Build reports and dashboards in Power BI, and advanced Excel models with pivot tables, charts, and lookup logic
Map and document existing data-pull processes, including feeds into Databricks, so they are repeatable rather than tribal knowledge
Ask questions about why a report exists and what decision it drives, and propose better ways to produce it
Work directly with client stakeholders clarify requirements, set expectations on timelines, and follow up until closed
Flag data quality problems and blockers early rather than delivering a report you know is wrong

What you need

3+ years in a data analysis or reporting role (analytics experience, not general BPO tenure)
Strong SQL joins, aggregations, subqueries, and the judgment to know when a result looks wrong
Advanced Excel INDEX-MATCH/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, charts, text manipulation, and cleaning messy source data
